Use when: A certified connector exists for the partner and the country
Mechanism: Configure the listed connector in the hub; partner enabled by tenant admin
Security: Partner-level and customer-level OAuth credentials; scopes per partner

Use when: Partner delivers an assessment, interview, check or verification and returns a result
Mechanism: Hub sends an order; partner returns status and result by callback or update call; attachment as signed link
Security: OAuth 2.0 client credentials; per-tenant consent; signed callbacks
Failure handling: Idempotent order ID; retry; dead-letter; reconcile daily
Used by interfaces: IF-11 to IF-14, IF-19 to IF-22

Use when: Job boards, referral tools, agencies or chat post applications
Mechanism: Partner calls the application interface with screening answers and consent
Security: Partner key or OAuth; rate limit; schema validation
Failure handling: Reject with reason code; replay queue

Use when: Jobs are pushed to boards and channels
Mechanism: Posting API, XML feed or board API; update and expire events
Security: Signed feed or token; IP allow-list where offered
Failure handling: Posting status poll; alert on rejected postings

Use when: Any downstream system needs near real-time status
Mechanism: Hub webhook to gateway to integration hub adapter; mapping to canonical model
Security: Signed payload; timestamp check; replay protection
Failure handling: Retry with back-off; dead-letter; manual replay

Use when: Analytics, audit and reconciliation need bulk or history
Mechanism: Reporting API or scheduled export to data platform
Security: Read-only scope; encrypted transfer; pseudonymised keys

Mechanism: SAML 2.0 or OIDC; SCIM; group-to-role mapping
Failure handling: Break-glass account; alert on provisioning failure

Use when: Partner has no API or sends large files
Mechanism: SFTP with PGP; landing zone; schema check
Security: Key pair; allow-list; encryption at rest
Failure handling: File arrival monitor; quarantine on schema error

Use when: Candidate or staff completes a step inside a partner experience
Mechanism: Signed deep link or redirect; result returns through IP-2
Security: Short-lived token; no personal data in the URL
